message: The variable '{0}' is declared as 'dynamic', so it must be initialized with an expression of type 'dynamic'. Declare the variable with 'var' or with a non-dynamic type.
title: A 'dynamic' variable must be initialized with a 'dynamic' expression.
rationale: The message says the variable cannot be 'set', but TemplateAnnotator only checks the initializer of a local declaration (VisitVariableDeclaration) and the collection of a foreach statement (VisitForEachStatement), not later assignments; it also lacks an article and gives no way forward.
